kebab_example: aliyun mpserverless create-function --name demoFunction --desc '测试函数' --space-id 226e5213-697c-4a52-b4ff-xxxxx --runtime nodejs12 --memory 512 --timeout 5 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFunction

parameters.help_en:
The function name.  
The name must be 1 to 30 characters long and can contain only letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with a digit or a hyphen.

The name of the cloud function must match the name of the Node.js code package to be uploaded
parameters.help_zh:
函数名称。
函数名称长度在1-30个字符间，只能包含字母、数字、下划线和中划线，不能以数字、中划线开头。

云函数的名称必须和要上传的Node.js代码包名称一致
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the service space to which the cloud function belongs
parameters.help_zh: 云函数所属的服务空间ID
parameters.name: space_id

parameters.help_en: Execution runtime of the cloud function. The default value is nodejs14. Valid values include nodejs12, nodejs14, and others. For more information, see the document Runtime Support List (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717618.html)
parameters.help_zh: 云函数执行环境，默认值为nodejs14，可选值为nodejs12,nodejs14等，详情参见文档《运行时支持列表》 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717618.html)
parameters.name: runtime

parameters.help_en: Memory specification for the function. The value must be a multiple of 64, with a minimum of 128 MB and a maximum of 2048 MB
parameters.help_zh: 函数内存规格，取值为64的倍数，至少128MB，至多2048MB
parameters.name: memory

parameters.help_en: The function timeout, in seconds. Default value is 5. Valid values range from 1 to 7200
parameters.help_zh: 函数超时时间，单位为秒，默认值为5，取值范围1-7200
parameters.name: timeout
